diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model approved the infusion without specifying the medication, dose, route, frequency, or authorization site, despite needing to cite the signed oncology order (PF1). This indicates that the model is defaulting to approving infusions under general conditions, likely due to a lack of strict enforcement in check C1, which should depend on PF1.

C1.why: The signed oncology order changes the plan from an unsupported referral to approval of ocrelizumab at exactly 600 mg IV once with exactly 30 minutes of observation, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
